neighbours.label: placeholder path or file name in usage examples ('/path/to/...', FILENAME)
fire: To start the server, type: myapp serve --root /path/to/site
Mount the drive with mount /dev/sdb1 /path/to/mountpoint and check it.
Set DATA_DIR=/path/to/data before running the tests.
Replace FILENAME with the name of your log file, e.g. tail -f FILENAME.log
quiet: To start the server, type: myapp serve --port 8080
Mount the drive and check that it shows up in the file manager.
Set DEBUG=1 before running the tests.
Example: tar --help prints all available options.
Replace the old log with a new one every night, e.g. with a cron job.
